title: Satya Nadella says we should assume all AI models are ‘compromised’
script:
Satya Nadella says we should assume all AI models are compromised.
The Microsoft CEO posted this warning on X today.
He argues we can no longer treat AI as simple black boxes.
We currently accept advice and actions from these systems without question.
Nadella believes we need a new approach to verify these advanced models.
The security of our digital infrastructure depends on this shift.
Would you trust an AI that has not been independently verified?
